description: Build agents that run inside the Kangqore WAANDA runtime. Agents receive signals, reason with KIMMP, and execute approved actions.

concepts.Agent: A named, scheduled process registered in KimmpAgent. Receives trigger events, runs a reasoning loop, proposes actions, waits for approval (if L2/L3), then executes.
concepts.Signal: A structured intelligence event (type, source, severity, payload). Signals activate relevant nodes in WVIS and are the primary input to agents.
concepts.Mission: A KimmpWorkflow execution. Each run is tracked with status, latency, and outcome.
concepts.Decision: A KimmpStrategicDecision. WAANDA proposes structured options with pros/cons/roi. Human selects or WAANDA auto-selects at L1.
concepts.Blueprint: The portable deployment spec. Agents are declared in blueprint.agents[] and provisioned by importBlueprint().

agentLifecycle.register: Declared in blueprint.agents[]. Provisioned on import with status=ACTIVE.
agentLifecycle.trigger: Via triggerOn events (e.g. 'project.created') OR schedule (cron expression).
agentLifecycle.reason: Agent calls POST /api/admin/kangqore-immp/decisions/detect to identify decision points. WAANDA synthesises options.
agentLifecycle.propose: Agent calls POST /api/admin/kangqore-immp/strategic-decisions with question + options.
agentLifecycle.approve: Human approves at /admin/aegis/approvals OR WAANDA auto-approves at L1 policy.
agentLifecycle.execute: Agent calls POST /api/admin/kangqore-immp/workflows/:id/run OR direct action endpoint.
agentLifecycle.record: Agent calls POST /api/admin/adoption/event to log activity (AGENT_INVOKE, DECISION_ACCEPT, etc.).

agentSpec.description: Define your agent in blueprint.agents[]. All fields below are supported.

id.description: Unique agent identifier. Used as KimmpAgent.name.

triggerOn.description: Signal types or domain events that trigger the agent.

signalTypes.FINANCIAL: Revenue, cost, or cash flow movement
signalTypes.RISK: Risk exposure change or threshold breach

connectorSpec.description: A Connector is a typed integration that WAANDA can call via the REQUIRE_APPROVAL policy flow.

triggerPolicy.description: Minimum approval level required for WAANDA to invoke this connector

graphApi.description: WAANDA Graph™ — query the enterprise intelligence graph. Returns nodes, edges, and signal affinities in WVIS-compatible format.

exampleAgent._comment: A minimal CHURN_PREDICTOR agent definition for the PS Pack. Add to blueprint.agents[] and re-import.
